title: Scarab with Cartouche of Thutmosis IV (1397-1388 BCE)
acquisition: Inscription metadata from official Walters art.csv export. Image from Walters donation to Wikimedia Commons. Longer artwork descriptions excluded.
text: Throne name of King Thutmose IV in a cartouche combined with a wish formula: Men-kheperu-Re, / who may live millions of years.

coverage_evidence: Museum renders the cartouche name plus the adjoining wish for millions of years.
